incidents.name: Uwerx WERX transfer burn from pair
incidents.notes: WERX's transfer() deducted its fee from the Uniswap pair's balance instead of the sender's, so a loop of tiny transfers to the pair burned the token reserve and let the attacker swap a small WERX position for nearly all of the pool's ETH.

sources.ref: onchain review: WERX 0x4306b12f8e824ce1fa9604bbd88f2ad4f0fe3c54 created 2023-02-07T16:19:23Z by 0x6a2a1481c09d55da3a733fae5691ee72f344555e, unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment. ~176 ETH x $1,856.80 at incidentTimestamp 1690965899 (DefiLlama) = $326,797.
